diagnostic_work_count_scope: verified policy work only; separate uninstrumented trials supply the score

trusted_program_contract.execution_labels: Action counts and receipt labels are read-only observations.

independent_block: new OS process and fresh managed CUDA/host pools for every arm in every block
manual_comparator: explicit hand-written MemoryProgram executed through the identical generated-program backend
memory_budget_scope: preallocated managed KV slots, including copy/COW/relay slots; fixed attention workspace is common and separately measured
paired_order: Williams balanced Latin rows, labels offset by fixed eval-ID SHA; odd label counts also use reversed rows
score: sum of per-case median total elapsed milliseconds; lower is better
score_scope: CUDA text-derived attention with physical KV lifecycles; no model-serving claim

selection_protocol.receipt_identity: Canonical ordered evaluator-reported receipt IDs, linked to the complete evaluation record.
selection_protocol.same_start: Each arm receives the same frozen starting view for its lane. Later slots see only their own rough results.
selection_protocol.training_identity: exact raw program SHA-256; dynamic physical equivalence is unproved

trusted_selection_contract.admission: The fresh child requires a distinct training identity and a stable paired validation gain over the fresh parent and historical incumbent.

finalists.admitted_output: Training-selected program actually emitted by an admitted source, with its editing parents recorded.
finalists.fixed: Training-selected program from the fixed seed archive.
finalists.manager_best: Training-selected program from the adaptive discovery archive with its original source attribution.

trusted_selection_contract.fresh_outputs: Parent and child select from their own newly emitted programs using the complete repeated training matrix.
trusted_selection_contract.incumbent: The historical manager incumbent is evaluated as a separate validation reference.
trusted_selection_contract.later_slots: Later slots see earlier rough measurements from their own branch. These are single-evaluation training feedback.
trusted_selection_contract.round_start: Adaptive parent and child share a frozen starting archive. Fixed branches use their own seed archive.
trusted_selection_contract.structure: Both generator entries need a structural change on the common round-start context. Reordering identical evidence IDs does not count.

timing_scope: all externally ordered work and mandatory final reclamation; allocation and compilation outside timing
training_effect_identity: exact raw program SHA-256; dynamic physical equivalence is unproved
